snippets.snippet: 7. The drawing(s) must be to scale and the scale used must be shown on the drawing(s). 8. The drawing(s) must list the total square feet of area encompassed by the property and the total square feet or area covered by all existing buildings including proposed additions. 9. Drawing(s) must show lot number(s) and street address. 10. Drawing(s) must list property owner ’ s name and mailing address. 11. Interim inspections must be completed at the following intervals: a. After the footer or foundation has been set in place. b. After the structure has been roofed. c. One to two weeks prior to compl etion. At this time , an Application for Zoning Certificate must be completed and approved by the Zoning Officer prior to occupancy.
